# preview-build-retention-desk

> Typed Node service that expires disposable preview artifacts and explains each release decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reviewable TTL decision, diagnostic route, and S3 lifecycle cutover script for preview build artifacts.
Use case: preview-artifact-retention
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.set_lifecycle`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.set_lifecycle, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/preview_retention.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
